chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Mu'awiyah ibn Shurayh, who said:

A man asked Abu Abdillah عليه السلام while I was with him, and said: Damp cold and snow affect us, and we want to perform wudu (ablution), but we find nothing except frozen water. So how should I perform wudu (ablution)? Should I rub my skin with it? He said: Yes.

key_terms.الدَّمَقُ: damp cold or severe chilly moisture affecting a person

ai.seo_question: How should wudu (ablution) be performed if only frozen water is available in snow and severe cold?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of wudu (ablution) in severe cold when only frozen water is available. Imam Abu Abdillah عليه السلام permits rubbing the frozen water on the skin, indicating a practical legal allowance for ritual purity under difficult conditions.
